title: AnyHarness manifest (plugin.json)
description: Machine-readable schema for an AnyHarness package manifest: the Agent Plugins 1.0 plugin.json base plus the dev.anyharness namespace (spec/manifest.md). The spec text is authoritative if it conflicts with this schema.

$schema.description: Canonical Agent Plugins manifest schema identifier, e.g. https://agent-plugins.org/schemas/1.0.0/plugin.schema.json. Selects the base spec version.

name.description: Plugin name (Agent Plugins 1.0 §5.5 constraints). Becomes the packages/<name>/ directory name.

version.description: Version string (Semantic Versioning RECOMMENDED). Required in practice for ManifestRef and update checks.

extensions.description: Client-specific manifest data keyed by reverse-domain namespace (Agent Plugins §8). Namespaces other than dev.anyharness are ignored without validation.

namespaceVersion.description: Version of the dev.anyharness data format. spec/manifest.md defines 1.

capabilities.description: Capabilities slots the package's components request (declaration, not grant).

harness.description: SemVer range (npm range syntax) evaluated against the AnyHarness implementation version.

componentsFormat.description: Frontmatter format version for commands/, agents/, rules/ files. Defaults to 1.

CapabilitySlot.description: Name of a host-injected environment slot. Seed set defined by spec/manifest.md §6 (e.g. storage, secrets, exec, network, fs); unknown slot names are ignored by hosts.

command.description: One executable token: bare name or './'-prefixed package-relative path (Agent Plugins §7.2.1 semantics).

hooks.description: Event name -> ordered hook entries. Unknown event names are ignored.
